sources.concept: Open netdevsim ethtool debugfs attribute backed by private data

impact.affected_asset: Freed netdevsim private allocation containing ethtool state.
impact.attacker_capability: Cause a stale-pointer dereference by retaining an ethtool debugfs attribute open across netdevsim teardown; the supplied record does not establish exploitation beyond the observed fault.

causal_trace.summary: The ethtool debugfs subtree exposes u32 attributes backed by addresses within the netdevsim private structure.
Before the fix, an open simple-attribute file could remain available after free_netdev released its backing netdevsim private data because the containing debugfs directory was removed later.
A read through the still-open debugfs attribute dereferences the stale u32 backing address in debugfs_u32_get.
KASAN reported a slab use-after-free read during network-namespace teardown.

failure.operation: debugfs_u32_get reads a four-byte u32 via a stale debugfs simple-attribute backing pointer

primary_invariant.statement: A debugfs attribute that directly references netdevsim private data must be removed and active users drained before free_netdev releases that data.
primary_invariant.violated_because: The ethtool debugfs subtree was removed only after nsim_destroy invoked free_netdev, allowing an open simple-attribute file to retain a pointer into freed private storage.

raw_refs.role: syzbot crash case and fix linkage

quality.review_notes: The bundle provides an observed KASAN report, a syz repro record, and an exact upstream root-cause patch. The attached reproducer program and build configuration were not individually extracted, and no standalone regression test or independently preserved post-fix run result is present. Netdevsim is described by the patch as a test harness not normally loaded on production systems.

remediation.invariant_restored: The ethtool debugfs subtree is tracked and removed before free_netdev on both destruction paths, so debugfs removal drains active users before its referenced netdevsim storage is freed.
mitigation_classes: remove externally reachable debugfs subtree before backing-object destruction
drain active debugfs file users before freeing backing storage
apply ordering on normal teardown and registration-failure cleanup paths

state_context.attacker_state_setup: An ethtool debugfs simple-attribute file must be open while netdevsim teardown releases the backing netdev private allocation.
data_structure_invariants: The ethtool debugfs dentry hierarchy must not outlive the netdevsim private storage addressed by its attributes.
Active debugfs users must be drained before free_netdev releases the referenced storage.
state_context.state_machine: EtHTool debugfs attributes are created against netdevsim private fields; prior teardown could free the netdev private allocation before removing the ethtool subtree; the fix removes the subtree first.

target.component: drivers/net/netdevsim ethtool debugfs subtree and netdev teardown

oracle.expected_negative: With the subtree removed before free_netdev, the supplied patch rationale expects debugfs removal to drain active file users; no standalone post-fix execution result is asserted here.
oracle.expected_positive: On affected ordering, a read of an open ethtool debugfs attribute after backing netdevsim storage is freed produces a KASAN slab-use-after-free report at debugfs_u32_get.
